criteria: confirmed or suspected tenant isolation breach
confirmed or suspected unauthorized disclosure of confidential/personal data
material data corruption or destructive write affecting production records
major degradation without confirmed data exposure
sustained warning signals with material user impact
authentication/authorization failure spike affecting legitimate users
warning signal without material user impact

safety_rules: Preserve request IDs, structured logs and audit evidence; do not paste secrets/tokens into incident notes.
Do not bypass authentication, MFA, CAPTCHA or provider permissions during recovery.
Do not run destructive database operations without an approved, evidence-backed recovery plan.
Use isolated restore validation before considering backup data trustworthy for recovery.
Treat suspected tenant isolation or data disclosure as a privacy/security incident immediately.
runtime_gaps: No deployed R09 log ingestion evidence while F08 is blocked.
No live R10 notification destination or acknowledgement drill.
No production C05 rollback procedure accepted yet.
Legal/privacy notification obligations require applicable-jurisdiction review and are not hard-coded by this precursor.
